in_greek.name: Ανάγνως
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word αναγνωσις (anagnoesis), meaning 'recognition', 'knowledge', or 'awareness'. The name Anagnos is derived from the verb αναγνωσκω (anagnoeko), which means 'to know', 'to perceive', or 'to recognize'. It is a name that reflects the idea of being known or recognized by God or others.
